title: Fossilmon Emissives
description: Glowing textures for the Fossilmon mod
body:
![Glowing Fossilmon Ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29544d63c473d0a2d82f2274e6c356fa86107947_0.webp)

## This resource pack makes all the ores from the fossilmon mod glow
This includes:
- Aerodactyl ore
- Kabuto ore
- Omanyte ore

### For this resource pack to function, you are going to need:
- [Fossilmon](https://modrinth.com/mod/fossilmon) and its [Dependencies](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) or [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home) and their respective dependencies

Thanks to the fossilmon and cobblemon teams for creating their wonderful mods, im soo addicted!

Please note that if you experience any artifacts, it is not an issue with this pack and it is called 'z-fighting', it is an issue with sodium <0.6 and unfortunately >0.6 is only available on the latest versions of minecraft, which fossilmon and cobblemon do not yet support.
This can be temporarily fixed with the [Glore](https://modrinth.com/mod/glore) mod, however, some config tweaking will be necessary to support the blocks from this resource pack.

🚫 Disclaimer: I want to make it clear that 'Fossilmon Emissives' is not affiliated with Fossilmon, Cobblemon or the official Pokemon franchise in any way. All rights and trademarks for Fossilmon, Cobblemon and Pokemon are owned by their respective creators and organizations.
